name: V2L / C2L Adapters
tagline: Convert the vehicle battery or charger to an external power source

products.name: V2L Adapter
products.subtitle: Vehicle-to-Load · Vehicle-to-Load
products.description: Adapter that converts the electric vehicle battery (V2L-enabled models) into a power supply to external devices. Ideal for camping and emergency power.

products.name: C2L Adapter
products.subtitle: Charger-to-Load·From Charge to Load
products.description: C2L adapter that converts the Type 2 charger into a power outlet for external devices. Suitable for fieldwork and camping.

products.name: V2L / C2L Combi Set
products.subtitle: Two Adapters in One
products.description: Combi set offering V2L and C2L adapters together. It allows you to get power from both the vehicle and the charger.

name: Overtime & Combination
tagline: Extend the charging cable or convert it to different plug types

products.name: Extension cable
products.subtitle: Type 2 Extension · 5m-25m
products.description: High current capacity extension cable that safely extends the distance between the vehicle and the charging station.

products.name: Schuko → Type 2 Adapter
products.subtitle: Converter Adapter
products.description: Adapter that converts the standard Schuko (CEE 7/4) plug into a Type 2 female socket. For use with portable chargers.

products.name: CEE 16a → Type 2 Adapter
products.subtitle: 3 Phase Blue Plug Adapter
products.description: CEE 16a blue three-phase plug to Type 2 female socket conversion adapter. For camping and industrial use.

products.name: Empty Combination Box
products.subtitle: Multiple Output · Distribution Unit
products.description: Compact combination distribution box providing multiple charging outputs from a single inlet connection.

name: Charging Unit Equipment
tagline: Type 2 socket, holster and mounting equipment

products.name: Type 2 Socket
products.subtitle: IEC 62196-2 · Female Panel Socket
products.description: High-quality Type 2 panel mounting socket used in the manufacture of charging station and wallbox.

products.name: Cable Holster
products.subtitle: Charging Cable Hanger
products.description: Wall-mountable cable holster that keeps the charging cable tidy and secure.

products.name: Ground Pole
products.subtitle: Free Standing Charging Unit Pole
products.description: Stainless steel floor post used to mount the wallbox in areas without walls.

products.name: Wall Mount Set
products.subtitle: Wallbox & Cable Holders
products.description: Stainless steel and ABS mounting equipment for securely fixing the wallbox and charging cables to the wall.

products.name: Cable Duct
products.subtitle: Cable Management & Protection
products.description: PVC cable duct and mounting accessories to fix the charging cable to the wall neatly and securely.

products.name: Electronic Control Board (ECU)
products.subtitle: Internal Control Unit · OEM

products.name: RFID Charging Card

products.name: Surge protectors
